title: Capstone: Support Desk Copilot
description: Capstone: turn five support documents into a pgvector knowledge base, triage thirty tickets with a local LLM, retrieve the passages that answer each one and draft grounded replies into PostgreSQL, all from one job.

checks.label: Your job runs your knowledge-base transformation (jb_support_copilot.kjb names load_knowledge_base.ktr)
Your job runs your ticket transformation (jb_support_copilot.kjb names answer_tickets.ktr)
Your knowledge-base transformation embeds the chunks (load_knowledge_base.ktr has a Text to Vector step)
Your knowledge-base transformation writes the vectors (load_knowledge_base.ktr has a Vector Writer step)
Your ticket transformation retrieves passages (answer_tickets.ktr has a Vector Search step)
Your ticket transformation asks the model (answer_tickets.ktr has an AI Chat step)
Your job wrote the replies (ticket_replies.csv in out\, with a needs_human column)
Your job wrote the triage summary (triage_summary.csv in out\, with a category column)
Your README.md in solution\ (how to run the job and read its results)
